text: 下面进入小作文 08 · 2025 英一母题：回复 Paul（Q1+Q2 双问驱动），英式思维与留白盲拼训练。
【2025 真题 · 回信防懵开口】遇到别人来信提两个问题，不要乱套建议模板！先感谢对方支持，再一句话概括回复的两件事：
Thank you for your email and warm support for our upcoming campus event. I am writing to share details about the craftsmen's show and how you can assist with our preparation work.
手术刀点拨：首段明确复述 Q1（show details）与 Q2（assist with preparation），让阅卷人一眼看出完全审清题干。
【Q1 核销 · 工匠展示内容】注意避免 porcelain / embroidery 这类高危拼写词！改用 paper cutting and clay art，加形式宾语：

First, regarding the demonstration, the young craftsmen will bring traditional works like paper cutting and clay art, showing how they combine old skills with modern designs. Students will certainly find it worthwhile to watch closely.
手术刀点拨：regarding 引出 Q1，comma showing 树状挂载，再用 find it worthwhile to do 优雅拔高活动体验感。
【Q2 核销 · 安排筹备工作】用 as for 切换至第二个任务，并给出两条具体好写的安全分工（摆桌椅、引导留学生）：
Second, as for the preparation work, it would be deeply appreciated if you could help arrange tables in the hall on Friday afternoon and guide other international students during the event.
手术刀点拨：First, regarding... 与 Second, as for... 是 2022–2025 连续 4 年多任务混合真题的万用劈段武器！
